tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph, edge to edge, no border. The long-neck bottle stands upright on white marble, its label square to camera, beside a tall clear glass already filled with pink soda over ice, fizzing, bubbles racing up and a few drops running down the glass. A pink hibiscus flower lies between them. Hard side light, the soda glowing. 85mm at glass height, the bottle label to camera.
